subject: houndeye
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: houndeye, in the place of the game's models/houndeye.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/gman.mdl, models/scientist.mdl, models/hassassin.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, C, A where the asset was C, A, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Matches the brief's words in all ten views. The body is squat and rounded with a crest of stripes on the back, the front is a broad face with the eye, and three legs show in the front and back views (sides.png). The legs are heavier at the thigh than the brief's 'thin' suggests in the side views, but no part sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Measured size 49.3 long and 44.7 high against the asked 49 and 45, a 0.6% offset (within 15%). Width 33.5 is not asked for.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, down to the small ones: body, three legs, the feet at the ends of the legs (splayed, visible in the front, back and side views), one large eye on the front (the dark dotted disc in the front, front-left and front-right views), and the stripes and dappled paint. All are present in the right places and number. The brief names no claws or teeth.

M4.reason: Yellow-olive body, cream underside, blue-teal and brown-orange stripes on the back, dark eye with a red rim. This matches 'yellowish' and the striped, dappled hide as the brief describes them (sides.png, below view).

M5.reason: The stripes are on the back and crest in bands at the right places (top view, back view), and the dappled mottling is on the flanks and body (left and right views). The front-right body shows some streaking, but it is at the sharpness of the game's own texture.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the rubric: the line-up test was measured apart. Three picks of the asset as the Valve one (A, C, A) never landed on the asset's position (C, A, B), so it was never picked as the odd one out. Passed.

M7.reason: The eye face is the front in both side views and the top view. The creature is upright and stands on its three feet on the floor line in the run frames (motion.png, frames 0, 3, 10, 13, 15, 18).

M8.reason: SMAK's check passed with no errors. 308 triangles is under the bound of 1152 (twice the median of Half-Life's own of its kind, 576, which is the larger of the two bounds). Nothing visible is open: the eye disc reads as a closed, textured organ, and the underside is a painted patch on the underbelly (below view). The legs and body are joined in every view, so nothing floats.

C1.reason: Through the run (motion.png, 18 frames) and the attack (attack.png, 59 frames), the legs stay attached and the feet touch the floor line at the stance frames. The body pitches and the rear leg stretches out in frames 10 and 13 but stays on the body. Nothing comes apart, sinks or floats. The original's motion is not in the pictures, so this is judged on the brief's words and on the body staying whole.
